column1: # Stage S8 V1c — the renderer contracts crate is born beside the frame: the render engine's statistics report

# subject it was first written for. The renderer contracts themselves are new code; the generic half of the
# frame's binding ids moves into them by hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
